liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (1 review): Foolish Heart sounds fresh, with Jerry using slightly different wording in some verses [18]
- **Louie Louie** (1 review): Louie Louie features a sax solo, assumed to be played by Brent [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-04-09.147845.sbd.ultramatrix.miller.flac24** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1989-04-09.148146.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min [2]
- **gd1989-04-09.156412.OTS-Schoeps-PCM-Master-Mattes-Anon-Noel.t-flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 165 min [5]
- **gd1989-04-09.sbd.tobin.tetzeli.fix-34962.75504.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [6]. Said about its sound: One soundboard version sounds too fast, resembling Alvin and the Chipmunks [14]
- **gd1989-04-09.fob.thompson.motb.83523.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 155 min; rated 3.9/5 by 10 [8]. Said about its sound: Audience recording features the widest stereo effect heard on the Archive; Big River and Ramble On Rose demonstrate the high quality of the recording [11][13]

## Around the show

- Venue hallways had low ceilings; space smaller than northeast arenas but larger than Ann Arbor [9]
- Show kicked into gear during Brent's second solo in Walkin' Blues, three weeks pre-Derby [19]
- Final performance of Louie Louie; deck pause eliminated the encore break before Knockin' On Heaven's Door [4]
- Spring 1989 tour lacked northeast venues; this show is nice but tunes are unspectacular [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-04-09.147845.sbd.ultramatrix.miller.flac24**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [1]
- **gd1989-04-09.148146.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [2]. Also: Two sets of masters used to complete the show; file is 16-bit at 44.1 [2]
- **gd1989-04-09.156412.OTS-Schoeps-PCM-Master-Mattes-Anon-Noel.t-flac16**: taped by Master Audience PCM recorded by Ted Mattes; transferred by Transfer by Anon Edited & Mastered (Adobe Audition) by Joe Noel December 10, 2021; source: (OTS) Schoeps CMC4/MK4 mics (ORTF) > Oade capacitor supply > Monster Cable ProLink > Sony pcm-f1 > Sony sl-2000 > PCM (Master) [5]. Also: Final of seven Louie Louie; transferred by Anon while hiding out away from the Bay Area [5]
- **gd1989-04-09.sbd.tobin.tetzeli.fix-34962.75504.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: fix of 34962 [6]
- **gd1989-04-09.fob.thompson.motb.83523.sbeok.flac16**: taped by D. Thompson; transferred by A. Egert/M. Townshend; source: Audience FOB Recording, 12th row DFC. AKG C460b preís with Ck61uls capsules > Uher CR240 > MAC [8]
